description.narrative: The project is implemented in East Jerusalem, Palestine. The main outcome areas it contributes to are Countering the threats to Democracy and Human Rights and Opposing the backlash increasing gender equality. The main rights holders are youth and children of East Jerusalem. Through skills development, cultural activities and awareness raising the project aims to achieve progressive development within the outcome areas.Project OrganisationsThe project is a cooperation between Old City Youth Association and ABF Botkyrka-Salem. Old City Youth Association is located in the Old City of East Jerusalem and functions as a community center where children and young people can come to learn about democracy, gender equality but also practice a number of cultural activities. ABF Botkyrka-Salen is a local popular education organisation that runs study circles, courses and cultural events and helps organisations build their operations in a suburb outside Stockholm.Other Donors to the OrganisationThere are no other donors in this specific project. OCYA draws funding from temporary donors, membership fees and local support.Project ObjectiveOCYA becomes a community center where inhabitants of East Jerusalem are educated to be activie citizens that have the capacity to address the problems facing the community in a democratic and peaceful manner.Actor groupsDecision makers: Minister of East Jerusalem, educational and social institutions, political leaders and informal community and religious leaders. Actors in Cooperation: NGOs working in Jerusalem, women's association and centers, including Palme Center partners in the city. Rights holders: children, youth and women of East Jerusalem.
